name: @arena/persistence-service
description: Persistence health/capacity/bootstrap service for Arena (Work Order B002; issue #64; spec/free-tier-contract.md FT2.0): composes adapters behind the @arena/persistence ports — ProviderHealthService (aggregated ProviderHealthSnapshot per provider + overall), CapacityService (quota visibility + the fail-closed no-fallback capacity guard), BootstrapService (deterministic migrations → seed-check, reproducible, safe re-run). Provider-neutral: ports only; adapters injected at composition time.
